To: j.hajduk@stateuniv.edu
From: alex.tan@stateuniv.edu
Sent: October 5, 02:15 P.M.
Subject: Clarification on History 302 Research Assignment
Dear Professor Hajduk,
I’m writing to request clarification on the guidelines for our History 302
research paper, due November 15. Specifically, I would like to confirm
whether the 12- to 15-page length requirement includes endnotes and
bibliography, or if those should be additional.
The assignment instructions mention a minimum of five secondary
sources, with at least two primary sources. However, I’m unsure
whether oral history interviews qualify as primary sources under these
guidelines. Could you clarify, please?
Your email dated September 24 states that citations should follow the
Chicago Manual of Style. Are full bibliographic details required in
endnotes or only in the bibliography?
Finally, is an annotated bibliography due with the initial draft on
October 20? Or can that wait until the final deadline?
Thanks in advance for your guidance.
Best,
Alex Tan
